Note::ensure_prefix¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::ensure_prefix(std::string_view prefix) const

Guarantee Each Cell Begins With A Prefix¶

ensure_prefix(prefix) returns a new Note, same shape as the input, in which every cell is guaranteed to start with the literal string prefix. A cell that already begins with the full prefix is left unchanged; any other cell has prefix prepended. It is the idempotent way to normalize leading markup — a scheme (https://), a mount point (/api/), a namespace, a bullet.

The check is a literal, exact prefix match: only when the cell’s first prefix.size() bytes equal prefix is it considered already-prefixed. A cell that starts with just part of prefix still gets the whole prefix prepended (see Example 2), which can produce a repeated fragment — pass the complete token you expect. ensure_prefix never removes anything; it is not the inverse of remove_prefix.

The operation is shape-preserving, cell-independent, and returns a fresh Note.

Example 1: Add A Leading Slash Where Missing¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::make_note({"path", "/path", "p/ath"}).ensure_prefix("/"))
    << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[3], dim=1, numel=3, encoding=utf8)
["/path", "/path", "/p/ath"]

"/path" already starts with / and is untouched; the other two get one prepended.

Example 2: The Whole Prefix Must Already Be Present¶

const pluss::Note n =
    pluss::make_note({"htt", "http://x"}).ensure_prefix("http://");
std::cout << n << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, encoding=utf8)
["http://htt", "http://x"]

"htt" is only a partial prefix, so the full "http://" is prepended, giving "http://htt".

Example 3: A Scalar¶

pluss::note::print(std::cout, pluss::make_note("users").ensure_prefix("/api/"))
    << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[], dim=0, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
"/api/users"

See Also¶

  • Note::ensure_suffix: the trailing-end counterpart.

  • Note::remove_prefix: strip a prefix if present.

  • Note::surround: add both a prefix and a suffix unconditionally.
